title: Tavern recruitment
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE polished full-screen desktop concept image for Pantheon Realms, a six-pantheon turn-based fantasy strategy game. Landscape 16:9. Entire interface within frame, straight-on screenshot, no device, no exterior mockup. Classic illustrated strategy-game feel: hand-painted stylized fantasy art, strong silhouettes, antique gold edging, deep navy panels, warm parchment, elegant readable serif headings and clear compact body text. Artistic but practical game UI, NOT a website or modern dashboard. Moderate ornament, coherent hierarchy and generous readable text. No logos from other games, no watermark, no modern app cards, no huge whitespace. Match the reference image's art and gold/navy palette but compose the entirely new requested screen. Reference is a STYLE guide, not an edit target. All requested labels crisp and correctly spelled. Do not add labels not requested, debug data, website header/footer or faux browser.
SCREEN: TAVERN RECRUITMENT. Header "The Tavern", small subtitle "Choose a hero to lead your next expedition." A wonderfully atmospheric Greek seaside tavern: carved wood, bronze lamps, amphorae, muted ivory marble, blue hangings. Two distinct heroes sit in the left two-thirds: Alexios, dark-haired bearded commander in bronze armor and blue cloak; Ione, auburn-haired oracle in ivory and gold with a staff. A discreet gold glow and portrait-name plaque selects Ione. Right third is a dark inset character panel with elegant framing: "Ione", "Oracle", "Divine insight and spellcraft." Four large meaningful pictograms with labels Attack 0, Defense 0, Power 3, Knowledge 3. Next "Starting army" with three small troop portrait slots and sample counts 12, 6, 2. "Starting skill" then Wisdom icon and "Wisdom". Bottom of panel coin icon "2,500 Gold" and clear gold/navy button "Recruit Ione". Screen bottom left "Available gold: 6,000"; bottom right secondary "Leave". Art dominates upper two-thirds. Hero identity, offer and primary action legible, no tiny dense paragraphs.
